Episode 236. The Fire of Annihilation, The Cruel Past (4)
Elona could not understand death.
She didn’t know what it meant for a person to lose someone they love.

All she could do was to shiver at the unexpected discomfort in the world. She wasn't able to feel the joy of communicating with others as a living being; instead, she was now in despair at the fact that she could never go back to the way she was.
The kingdom where the sanctuary was located had disappeared, but the sanctuary beneath its ruins still shone green. The tree from which Elona emerged was also firmly rooted.
“Ugh…”
Every day, Elona huddled inside the split crevices of the tree, wanting to become a tree again.
But just as a life once born cannot return to its mother, Elona could never merge with the tree.
Still, Elona slept in the tree every day. It was a place that could somewhat mask the cruel smells of humans and the world.
A complete, safe, and desire-less state.

When Elona was a tree, there was no lack, but now it was not so. Occasionally, a horrible smell and energy that could not be hidden even by the scent of the tree seeped into the sanctuary, and every time, Elona emerged from the tree and roared for a long time.
Eventually, Elona began to contemplate what she needed to do to find peace again. Despite hiding quietly in the tree, unclean and unpleasant things kept coming.
It didn’t take long to find the answer.
Go out and eradicate all land and life except this place.
That was the conclusion Elona came to.
She remembered the kingdom she smashed on the day Reginald fled. Despite the enormous slaughter and destruction that left not a single survivor, Elona did not hear even a single scream from them.
The kingdom on the ground had disappeared solely from the magic she fired from her spot just to get rid of Reginald.
Elona had a sense of the size of the world even from where she sat.
It took her an hour to annihilate the kingdom. Considering that, it seemed to take about ten days to destroy the entire human world.
If there were humans like Reginald who fiercely resisted or tried to escape, it might take more time.
Even taking such variables into account, it seemed it wouldn't take more than a month.

Moreover, that task felt as natural as something she had wanted from before birth. Elona didn't know she was an entity created by the destructive desire of the sun god, but she instinctively wanted destruction.
However, there was a problem. She would have to leave the tree for a while to complete her mission. Roaming outside, leaving her only sanctuary behind, felt extremely dangerous.

Even if she didn't understand hatred, she had personally experienced humans finding her. As she was absent, she worried about what these harmful life forms would do to the tree, and her sleepless nights increased.
After a few days, Elona was able to witness her ominous premonition becoming reality.
"My brother... The devil who killed Bechelin is here."
It was Reginald.
With his tense red eyes, he led an army to the sanctuary. Mercenaries hired, the elite knights from allied countries, and the Zipple mage group were trampling around the sanctuary.
There were about five hundred of them.

However, there was no one Elona felt threatened by. Even the strongest of them, Reginald, couldn't even cause a scratch on her. Those weaker than him were less threatening than the air itself. If Elona was a beast, most of them couldn't even be flies.
The uncomfortable heat emitted by the humans was making the sanctuary boil.
Elona waited until they came close to the tree. The humans surrounding the tree looked terrified, and Reginald took a position in the back.
"Is this really the tree?"
"This is a strange space... As Reginald said, I don't feel any hunger or fatigue at all."
Swoosh!
The moment a group of knights and mercenaries stood in front of the tree, Elona casually swung her hand and took their lives.
And before their dirty blood could touch the sanctuary, she ignited a fire and evaporated it. Her mana and flames, stretching out like a sword, killed the people gathered nearby in an instant.
At that moment, most of the humans who had come to the sanctuary lost their momentum.
"Ah, Aaaah!"
"What the...!"
Reginald had no interest in those running away in shock. He gave a dry command to the mages of Zipple to set up a barrier.
"Sir Reginald! What are you doing, blocking the exit!"
Reginald didn't answer and focused his gaze on Elona wielding her transcendent power.
The mercenaries and allies who followed Reginald mostly consisted of people with middle-to-lower class abilities.

"She begins the slaughter without any hesitation. Her power is beyond Genesis. She might even surpass Lord Shinu. But as expected, her combat style is endlessly crude and lacks depth. Just like a beast."
Reginald brought the knights and mercenaries as disposable items to gauge Elona.
"What kind of battle strategy she mainly uses, whether there is any weakness, whether recovery time is needed after using her powers.
If they could ascertain this fact with the pitiful lives of the mercenaries and low-ranking knights, Reginald was prepared to sacrifice them time and again.
"There's a sense of attachment to the tree... The damned monster girl, is she perceiving the tree as her mother? Moreover, she's being careful not to let the blood splash on the ground."
"Certainly, it appears that way. It seems this monster is extremely wary of the tree and this land being damaged."
"It's a good harvest. Let's retreat for now. Tomorrow, we'll deploy a thousand men."
"Understood, lord."

Elona aimed her magic at Reginald who was fleeing, but he had already perfectly figured out the monotony of Elona's attacks from their first meeting. The beam of magical energy she shot failed to hit Reginald and his departing party.
From that point on, Reginald led his army to the sanctuary every day.

On fewer days, a hundred, and on more days, nearly a thousand people were used as bait. The allied countries and mercenaries continued to obey Reginald's commands, knowing that those sent would not return. To defy him meant losing their place in the world.
Elona was becoming increasingly troubled because of this.

She couldn't leave her post due to the incessant swarm of vermin. Oddly enough, Elona noticed that they were gradually becoming attached to the tree. It was because Reginald had realized she cherished the tree.
Having identified her weakness, Reginald persistently irritated Elona's nerves.
The day Reginald finally decided to have a showdown with Elona, he brought with him part of the elite magic corps of Zipple and the knight known as the best of his time to the sanctuary.
Unlike those who had been used as expendable items until now, they were people who could properly attack Elona.
The magic corps would bombard her, and while Elona was busy defending, the knight would approach the tree and attack. It was a simple tactic.
Boom, rumble...!
As the magic corps' bombardment relentlessly poured onto the sanctuary, Elona easily blocked their attack.
However, she noticed the knight approaching the tree amidst the chaos too late, and the knight managed to leave a long and deep sword mark in the middle of the tree.
"Aaaah!"
Then, Elona let out her first agonized scream and rushed to the tree. She lost her sanity, clutching the tree and breaking into tears.
The knight was torn apart and killed by the energy emanating from Elona at that moment, but for Reginald, it was the moment he was assured of his future victory.

Furthermore, after that day, Elona showed signs of suffering for quite a while. Reginald led an expedition every day to observe her condition, and she was so weak that she wouldn't even attack even if they got closer than usual.
"If we get very close, she swings her hand to disperse magic, but she doesn't persistently slaughter the army as before. Just like a person whose will has been broken.
"Gather all the Knights of White Night and the Tower Lords who are on standby. Tomorrow, we're going to tear that monster apart and avenge Bichelin."
That's how the maximum number of troops were gathered to the sanctuary.
The knights were bloodthirsty to become the true greatest of this era by successfully subduing Elona, and Reginald spoke with a cold smile,
"Begin the hunt."
No matter how strong Elona was, a battle couldn't be established if the prey was so clear. To Reginald, Elona fell from an object of worship to a hunted game.
The hunt was fully prepared. The knights could approach the tree much more easily than the first knight who bent the tree, and the wizards boldly poured out their magic.
Elona exploded with magic in anger, and despite her simple attack, many wizards were swept away and killed.
However, as soon as the knights' swords began to damage the tree, she had no choice but to crumble like a mound of sand.
The knights, learning from the death of the previous knight, blocked her approach with their swords against the tree. They used the tree as a hostage.
At that time, the subjugation party was able to hear Elona speak for the first time,
"No, stop..."
That was the phrase Elona heard most since she was born into this world. As she killed numerous expedition members who were used as expendables.
Without realizing it, Elona was imitating their words. She also knelt down and rubbed her hands like them.
"Ha, hahaha...!"
Looking at her, Reginald approached Elona with a mad laughter.
"Lords, it's dangerous!"
"Lords!"
Despite the dissuasion of his confidants, Reginald stood in front of Elona with his bare body and looked down at her. Elona was crying and repeating words asking to save the tree.
"You killed my brother and killed so many lives like catching bugs, and you can't stand to see your precious thing hurt?"
"Stop, stop..."
Reginald, seeing Elona completely submissive, was lost in thought for a moment.
"I was originally going to kill you right away. But it seems there could be a better revenge. Yes, my thought was short. I can't kill you so easily..."
Reginald, wiping his smile, said this,
"From today, this monster is the asset of Zephyr. Uproot the tree from its roots and move it to the lab of the First Tower along with this monster."
